# Sela 1.2

Three products sharing one lightweight reader: Viewer CDN for websites/frameworks; Home desktop new-tab extension with bookshelf, clock/calendar, coffee, original offline quotes and optional city weather; Bookshelf mobile app installed through Add to Home Screen with a bottom bar and IndexedDB library. Start at https://bobbyfch.github.io/sela/#products.

Home packages: Chromium/Firefox New Tab recommended, Standard compatibility. Safari signing/package is not available. Mobile: Android/iPhone/iPad with modern browser capabilities; iPhone 4 only basic page/PDF links, not full PWA. OS install routing is a UX guard, not tamper-proof enforcement.

PDF (lazy PDF.js), EPUB, CBZ, TXT/MD/sanitized HTML/text FB2. Optional external GPL DjVu decoder; CBR/MOBI/AZW/DOCX/DRM unsupported. Search, embedded outlines, browser TTS, notes, filters/brightness/dim; no PDF aligned text layer, EPUB CFI, OCR or synchronization.

Both shelves: search, newest/title/last-read sorts, format/status/favorites filters, shelf/grid/list modes, original export, rename/remove/undo. Five example covers: one full novelet, four labeled text layout placeholders. Books saved explicitly in IndexedDB, not uploaded or stored in service-worker asset cache. Browser eviction is possible. Preserve originals.

Home weather: Open-Meteo free hosted endpoint is non-commercial, opt-in city, no GPS, attribution, optional extension permission. Quotes are original local EN/ID copy.

Install: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/install.md

Pinned CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bobbyfch/sela@v1.2.0/dist/js/sela.min.js
FlippyPDF main preserves v1.0.0 assets and directs new users to Sela. Historical CDN caches cannot be recalled.
